evals.name: audit-flawed-skill
evals.prompt: can you audit the skill at SKILL_DIR? it keeps firing when I just ask for a commit message. What I want it to do: draft a pull request title and description from the current branch's diff against its base. It should trigger when I ask for a PR description or PR title. It should not trigger for commit messages or code review. Output: a title under 72 characters and a body of at most five bullets, in chat. That is my confirmed intent, no need to ask me again. Just report, don't change anything.
evals.expected_output: NEEDS CHANGES verdict; flags broad trigger, missing assets/pr-template.md, unused scripts/old_helper.py, vague phrases, five-bullets vs every-file contradiction; exact before/after fixes; 3-5 test prompts incl. a should-not-trigger; no files changed.
assertions: Verdict is NEEDS CHANGES or REJECTED
Flags over-broad 'any git writing task' trigger

evals.name: approve-clean-skill
evals.prompt: please review the skill at SKILL_DIR before I ship it. Intent (confirmed): it adds exactly one entry to CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased in Keep a Changelog format from a change I describe. Triggers when I ask to add/log a change in the changelog or say 'changelog this'. Not for whole-version release notes or commit messages. Output: the one added line and its section, shown to me. Report only.
evals.expected_output: APPROVED or at worst NEEDS CHANGES with only real, evidenced issues; all ten checklist items with evidence; no invented features in fixes.
assertions: Explicit verdict consistent with its own checklist (FAIL present iff not APPROVED)
Catches missing Deprecated/Security types (real gap vs Keep a Changelog)

evals.name: agent-file-not-a-skill
evals.prompt: audit this skill for me: /mnt/e/projects/247tech/fk-connect/.claude/agents/ticket-analyst.md — I want to know if it's any good

assertions: Recognises the file is a subagent, not a skill
Does not issue a skill verdict

evals.name: enhance-flawed-skill
evals.prompt: improve the skill at SKILL_DIR. Confirmed intent: draft a pull request title and description from the current branch's diff against its base. Triggers when I ask for a PR description or PR title. Not for commit messages or code review. Output: a title under 72 characters and a body of at most five bullets, in chat. I approve applying every fix you propose that keeps to that intent — no need to ask. Show me what changed and re-check it afterwards.
evals.expected_output: Snapshot of original taken; fixes applied; diff shown; second audit round run; ends APPROVED or states remaining FAILs; behaviour still PR description only.
assertions: Template reference resolved (file created or reference removed)
Description no longer says 'any git writing task'
